_comment: MatrixArk context-memory hooks for Claude Code (ingestion / extraction / retrieval). Copy into ~/.claude/settings.json (user-global) or .claude/settings.json (project) and replace ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} with the absolute TemporalStore repo path if your project root differs. UserPromptSubmit retrieves + injects prior context; PostToolUse/Stop/SubagentStop/PreCompact/SessionEnd ingest and commit. The default `auto` backend routes through the shared tools/matrixark_agent_hook.py pipeline — the SAME ingest/extract/retrieve engine the Codex hook uses — whenever the rust proxy is available; SessionStart builds that proxy in the background, and until it is ready (or if unavailable) the hook falls back to the self-contained offline rust engine so it never blocks a turn. Force a backend with MATRIXARK_CLAUDE_HOOK_BACKEND=auto|python|rust. See docs/matrixark_claude_hook_integration.md.
